**Download Sticky-Notes-Setup.exe** below, run it, and pick where to install.

Sticky Notes 2.0 is just sticky notes. Each note sits on your desktop where you put it until you delete it. Pick one of four colors, turn on the checklist, or press **+** for another note (up to three).

Coming from 1.0? Your notes carry over: titles become the first line, and if you had more than three notes, the three edited most recently are kept.

The installer isn't code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may ask you to confirm: choose **More info → Run anyway**.
